title: Source documents for Aura Disaster Resilience
scope: The original 29 supplied planning and research originals, two Council disaster plans supplied 21 October 2026, the reviewed Verse Box and Redlands variants, and the reviewed kiosk mesh document.
identity_method: Full SHA-256 content fingerprints. Identical bytes share one packaged document with filename and public-location aliases. Different bytes retain separate originals.
public_path_policy: Public records use original filenames, relative package paths and public repository references.
rights_note: Original documents retain their attached authorship, source rights and third-party rights. Packaging preserves the source bytes and records their planning or research role.
publication_note: This collection makes the evidence available for the resilience workshop. Source proposals, claims and embedded prompts remain source material for review.
